name: CNN-based Image Retrieval
aliases: CNN-based Image Retrieval — AlexNet retrieval, Image retrieval compartment
definition: A retrieval method using a pre-trained Convolutional Neural Network (AlexNet) to extract high-level spatial semantics from co-planar images along the ray for matching against a knowledge database.
summary: CNN-based Image Retrieval matches co-planar images via deep learning to retrieve transfer functions, distinguishing segments by spatial semantics rather than intensity alone.
